text: Oh, Kit, what have you done? You, in whom I trusted so much, and who were almost the only friend I had!’ The unfortunate Kit looked at his young mistress harder and harder, and with eyes growing wider and wider, but was perfectly motionless and silent. ‘I have brought his money for the week,’ said the child, looking to the woman and laying it on the table--‘and--and--a little more, for he was always good and kind to me. I hope he will be sorry and do well somewhere else and not take this to heart too much. It grieves me very much to part with him like this, but there is no help.
